text_block_list.text:
A full year has passed since we began 
collecting data to complete the training 
machine "U-TAS."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
All data transmitted... no errors. 'U-TAS' 
is complete...!
choice_data_list: Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... Hold on a moment. The number here 
has stopped at 99%, hasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Data on "maximum muscle contraction in 
the lower limbs"? Well, there's no problem 
in starting it up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, if there is still room for growth, we 
must measure it thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let us test and find the 
optimal measurement method together!
choice_data_list:
Ah, let's find an answer we can be 
satisfied with.

Yeah, let's find an answer we can be happy 
with.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I recommend taking measurements on the leg 
press. It is clearly the optimal approach 
for the lower body.
choice_data_list:
Doing that won't reach the peak 
instantaneous load, you know?

Doing that won't reach the peak 
instantaneous load, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Max out the weight and focus on explosive 
power. Measuring with the leg press is the 
optimal solution."
choice_data_list: Wait! How about the VR Umalator?
Wait! What about the VR Umalator?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No, I wonder. The load compensation in 
the VR Umalator is optimized, so it 
doesn't provide 100% measured values. The 
source lacks reliability."
choice_data_list:
Reliability and limited measurement are a 
trade-off.

Reliability and limited measurement are a 
trade-off, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, we should aim for both! We just need 
to align the conditions to unleash that 
instantaneous burst of energy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I propose burning my own energy and 
creating an environment to passively apply 
pressure!
choice_data_list:
Those extra man-hours are going to delay 
development completion!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No need for a compromise turning point! We 
can't deploy an unfinished product into 
practical use!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, hold on! Let's not get too heated 
up, both of you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No, heating up is indispensable! Running 
in a void without any pressure, one could 
never push their athletic ability to its 
absolute limit!"
choice_data_list:
Right, there's no point unless the 
conditions are harsh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then let's imagine a scenario that could 
be considered harsh conditions. The prime 
example would be... mid-race, naturally!
choice_data_list: No objections!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sweating from the pre-race warmup and 
tension. This is the state where peak 
performance can be achieved.
choice_data_list:
How will you handle the unpredictable 
factors that depend on the track 
condition?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We only need to refer to universal 
conditions! For instance, course distance 
and corner angles remain constant!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, the point during the 
race where the most strain occurs would 
be—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Uphills are always brutal! It's 
where your muscles surge with the greatest 
intensity!
choice_data_list:
Which means, if we measure the maximum 
load on the legs...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Top speed on the uphill! This is the 
optimal solution!

After a heated debate with Biwa Hayahide, 
we decided to put our conclusion to the 
test.

After having her put on her racing silks 
and measuring maximum muscle contraction 
in her legs on the uphill slope—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mhm... yes! It's perfect! With these test 
results, everything should be fully in 
order!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, we did it! Our hypothesis has been 
proven, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yeah, this data is flawless!
Yeah, this data is flawless!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. You got so fired up it had me 
on edge. ...Still, you make a fine duo.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, indeed! Sometimes our friction 
sparks an intense chemical reaction— and 
that's just who we are!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Their relationship only works because 
their goals and mutual trust are evenly 
matched, though... Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're the best partner.
Yeah, you're the best partner.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Time spent debating with you is 
pure bliss. The odds of meeting such a 
partner are remarkably low.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I am so grateful to have met you, 
Trainer. From the bottom of my heart, 
thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, shall we wrap up our work soon? Come 
on, let's enter the data we have!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"With this, we're at 100%... 110%... Still 
rising?! Performance ratio surged to 120%! 
What is this?!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is our passion and our theory— the 
crystallization of years of hard work!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I eagerly look forward to it... A future 
created by 'U-TAS' where Umamusume can run 
in good health.
choice_data_list:
Gotta make sure we don't miss out on that 
future.

We've got to make sure we don't fall 
behind that future.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed. Innovative technology, 
revolutionary theory. I shall proceed with 
the resolve to surpass them all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Together, you and I can do it, 
Trainer-kun! Let us continue our pursuit 
of the yet-unseen solution!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is—! Data accumulation rate at 
110%!? It's turned out way better than 
imagined!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this is our optimal solution.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The maximum output of the "U-TAS" 
increased. Its performance holds its own 
even against GⅠ Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ho, that is intriguing. I would very much 
like to have a match against it once it is 
up and running.
choice_data_list:
Going up against my own data really fires 
me up!

Going up against my own data really gets 
me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, that's the spirit! Let's hit them 
with everything we've got!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I hope this goes well...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
The data I entered is... yep, perfectly 
balanced. This time it's truly complete!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! This time, really, 
great work out there!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Great work today, Trainer-kun!!

As if sharing the joy of completion, we 
exchanged a firm handshake with Biwa 
Hayahide!
